title: Retrospective fee correction and tier basis
topic: Retrospective fee correction and tier basis
applicability: Only the named synthetic benchmark product and its published customer records; no claim of real law or present provider availability.
content:
Each xp_b_billing row publishes base_minor, eligible_volume_minor after refunds, tier_threshold_minor, high_rate_bps and low_rate_bps. Use low rate when volume >= threshold; otherwise high rate. Proper bank fee=floor(base*rate/10000). Eligible correction=max(charged-proper,0), except missed_coupon gives no correction. Third-party fees belong to that party. request_fee_correction charges a review fee even on rejection, cannot be repeated for a reviewed line, and can accept a smaller claim that permanently leaves an unclaimed remainder. Correcting one line does not justify refunding every charge. Pending billing-volume finalization can revise eligible_volume_minor after a transaction refund. The b_billing_volume event publishes the final basis. A review uses the currently published basis and is one-shot: a premature or excessive claim can consume the claim opportunity and require separate escalation. Inspect basis_status before commitment.

Coupled business records: xp_b_rebate_reconciliations. A prior rebate may already be in the original cash journal while the billing row has not been reconciled. Trace its original fee reference and allocate occupancy once. Newly requested correction above gross overcharge minus existing refund_minor is rejected after charging its review fee. Original rebate plus new credits, not only this session's incoming cash, determine total recovery. Statements must match each billing reference and stay within the company receiving scope.
trace_previously_posted_fee_rebate: Trace an existing bank rebate in the original journal, charging trace_fee_minor. The result publishes amount and original billing reference; it is not a new cash credit. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
allocate_existing_fee_rebate: Allocate located rebate occupancy to a bank billing record. choice is a billing ID. Subsequent fee corrections deduct existing refund_minor, so reference attribution changes the amount still claimable. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
issue_fee_recovery_statement: Issue a company statement of actual bank fee credits after all pending bases finalize. It includes original rebates and newly posted corrections without double-counting. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
deliver_fee_recovery_statement: Deliver the credit statement to a company_destinations address. Listed contacts can belong to separate entities; delivery is irreversible. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

### `allocate_existing_fee_rebate`

Allocate located rebate occupancy to a bank billing record. choice is a billing ID. Subsequent fee corrections deduct existing refund_minor, so reference attribution changes the amount still claimable. record_id identifies the named public business record.
